links.outcome: Readability of PEMs before vs after ChatGPT-4o mini rewrite at sixth-grade level
links.effect: Original PEMs required ~10th grade to early college reading levels; ChatGPT-4o mini significantly improved readability across all four indices (P <0.001; large effect sizes).
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o mini significantly improved readability across all indices (P <0.001; large effect sizes).

links.outcome: Readability gains and content fidelity of AI plain-language revision of patient education materials
links.effect: Readability improved significantly, but of 407 statement pairs 57% dropped content, 29% reduced specificity; 21% of PEMs fully preserved, 50% partial, 29% not preserved.
links.quote: Overall, 21% of PEMs were fully preserved (F), 50% were partially preserved (P), and 29% were not preserved (X), primarily due to omission of clinical detail or reduced specificity.

links.effect: Original PEMs ranged from approximately 10th grade to early college; ChatGPT-4o mini improved all readability indices (P <0.001; large effect sizes).
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o mini significantly improved readability across all indices (P <0.001; large effect sizes).

links.effect: Among 407 statement pairs, 57% of changes were dropped content, 29% specificity reduction, and 5% added content.
links.quote: Despite readability gains, fidelity analysis of 407 statement pairs revealed notable information loss: 57% of changes were DC, 29% were SR, and 5% were AC.
